definitions.explanation: Describes products, materials, or goods that are of low quality, poorly made, or substandard. A fairly strong negative assessment, stronger than simply 'cheap.'

examples.japanese: {粗悪|そあく}な⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気|き}をつけて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be careful of inferior products.

examples.japanese: {粗悪品|そあくひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つかまされて⟦{損|そん}→損：03325_son⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was stuck with a shoddy product and took a loss.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}ったら→買う：00489_kau⟧、{粗悪|そあく}な⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}られていて→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れた→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧。
examples.english: I bought a cheap product online, but it was made of shoddy materials and broke right away.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly modifies nouns like ⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧ (product), ⟦{品|しな}→品：03192_shina⟧ (goods), ⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧ (material). The compound {粗悪品|そあくひん} (inferior goods) is very common. Often appears in consumer warnings, product reviews, and news about counterfeit goods.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {粗悪品|そあくひん} (inferior goods; shoddy product)
- {粗悪|そあく}な⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧ (poor-quality materials)
- {粗悪|そあく}な{模造品|もぞうひん} (shoddy counterfeit)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{低品質|ていひんしつ}→低品質：23685_teihinshitsu⟧: low quality — more neutral and technical
- ⟦{安物|やすもの}→安物：22116_yasumono⟧: cheap goods — emphasizes low price rather than poor quality itself
